name: Bangladesh solar home systems program
description: A national off-grid program financed and delivered photovoltaic electricity systems to rural households.

impact.note: One national programme that brought basic electricity to millions of rural households and was copied by a few later off-grid schemes.

places.note: Place refers to the sourced event; historic political boundaries are not inferred.

date.basis: Date stated in the cited source.

events.statement: The government began a solar home systems program under IDCOL leadership.

evidence.locator: Program background, sales and finance paragraphs
evidence.supports: The Bank says the government launched the off-grid program under IDCOL leadership in 2003 with World Bank and other partners’ financing; it reports over 4.1 million units sold by 2018 and approximately 20 million people served.

events.caveats: Program commencement does not establish the first individual system installation.
